title: Kākoʻo iā My Quiet Bible
description: He manuahi ʻo My Quiet Bible no nā mea a pau, mau loa. Inā he kōkua ia iā ʻoe, hiki iā ʻoe ke kōkua i ka hoʻāʻā mau ʻana i ke kukui.
sub: Manuahi no nā mea a pau, mau loa. Inā he kōkua ia iā ʻoe, hiki iā ʻoe ke kōkua i ka hoʻāʻā mau ʻana i ke kukui.
kofiSub: Hoʻokahi manawa, a i ʻole i kēlā me kēia mahina. Me ke kāleka, Apple Pay a i ʻole Google Pay, ʻaʻohe kākau inoa.
leave: Wehe ʻia ma kahi ʻaoʻao hou. E hoʻi mai i ʻaneʻi, a i ʻole i ka Baibala, ke pau.
btcSub: On-chain a i ʻole Lightning, pololei i kā mākou kikowaena ponoʻī, ʻaʻohe kanaka waena a ʻaoʻao ʻekolu paha.
btcAddressQr: Code QR o ka helu wahi Bitcoin
where:
• Nā kikowaena e hoʻoholo ana i ka hoʻolike a me nā pōʻai.
  • Nā inoa kāpili, i hana mau ai ʻo myquietbible.com.
  • Ka leka uila e hoʻouna ana i nā helu komo.
never: ʻAʻole loa e laka ʻia kekahi mea o ka Baibala. He mahalo ka hāʻawi ʻana, ʻaʻole he likiki komo, a ʻaʻohe mea e loli ma ka polokalamu inā hāʻawi ʻoe a ʻaʻole paha.
tax: ʻAʻole ʻo My Quiet Bible he hui aloha i kākau inoa ʻia, no laila ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻēmi ʻia ka ʻauhau no nā makana.
otherH: Nā ala ʻē aʻe e kōkua ai
other:
• E pule no kēia hana, a no ka poʻe e heluhelu ana me ia.
  • E hoʻouna iā myquietbible.com i kekahi e makemake ana i kahi Baibala mālie.
about: He aha ʻo My Quiet Bible?
